title: Paloma Rewards Courtesy on Cash Pickup Shortfall Credits
content:
**Paloma Rewards programme note.** When Paloma books a shortfall credit on a short Cash Pickup payout, a loyalty courtesy is added to the credit. It follows the tier of the sender's Paloma Rewards membership whose status is active.

| Sender's active Paloma Rewards tier | Loyalty courtesy added to the shortfall credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Gold, Paloma Rewards Platinum, Paloma Rewards Diamond, Paloma Rewards Elite | 3.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Blue, Paloma Rewards Silver | 1.50 |
| no active membership | none |

The courtesy is a fixed amount in US dollars. It is not a percentage and does not depend on the size of the shortfall.

## Examples (hypothetical)

- An active Paloma Rewards Diamond member: 3.00 is added.
- An active Paloma Rewards Blue member: 1.50 is added.
- A sender whose Paloma Rewards membership is not active: nothing is added.
